selection_basis: lowest 14 numeric subjects after discovery subject sub-01; fixed before any signal-derived outcome from these subjects
source_identity_rule: For each pinned path, resolve the git-annex EEG object key from the pinned GitHub commit before raw download; parse expected size and MD5 from that key; fetch VHDR/VMRK from the same pinned commit; then download EEG from the declared NEMAR mirror and require exact size/MD5 before feature extraction.
metadata_firewall: Only subject identity, session, task, acquisition/decoding metadata, and exact source identity are visible to this replication. Demographic, questionnaire, behavioral, symptom, and clinical fields are excluded.
claim_ceiling: Untouched within-dataset independent-subject descriptive replication of the session-pair pattern only; no modal damping, natural frequency, lowercase chi, capital Chi, diagnosis, recovery, treatment, or broad population generalization.
